about: Saint-Zotique is a municipality in Vaudreuil-Soulanges, Quebec, on Lac Saint-François at the west end of the Montréal region—not a borough of the island city. A beach town with canal and lakeshore parks, it sits along Highway 20 toward Ontario. About 10,000 people live in Saint-Zotique.
seoSummary: Vaudreuil-Soulanges lakeshore municipality on Lac Saint-François—beaches and Highway 20 west of Montréal.
